messages:
Alex: Putting up a short PRD stub for an SDK surface that handles timeouts, delegation, and a privacy opt-out. Need quick alignment before we convert this into an RFC. Primary asks from product/customers:
- client-side delegation of deadlines (per-call vs per-stream)
- clear defaults for retries/backoff ergonomics
- streaming cancel semantics + server fallback behavior
- a privacy knob for enterprises (redaction/partial prompt opt-out)

Priya: quick Q — which customer asked for the privacy knob? can you share the ask context?

Alex: PineHealth (enterprise) asked for two things: 1) ability to prevent partial prompts or prefixes from leaving their VPC/hosted path, and 2) telemetry opt-out for enterprise deployments. They don't need full KMS integration in this milestone, just a config surface + docs showing tradeoffs.

Sam: SDK ergonomics opinion: prefer explicit `deadline`/`timeout` params surfaced on all call types. Hidden timeouts in transport lead to surprises. Example API sketch:

```
client.generate(prompt, { deadlineMs: 1500, retry: { maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'expo' } })
```

Jordan: For streaming we should allow both overall deadline and per-chunk read timeout. Example pattern:

```
const stream = client.stream.chat({ model: 'redwood-l1', timeoutMs: 5000, chunkTimeoutMs: 500, onPartial: (delta) => {} });
// stream.cancel() should surface a cancel type so server doesn't double-emit or mark as error.
```

Mei: edge case: if client exhausts retries and then server triggers a fallback model (lighter quantized variant), we must avoid duplicate tokens or truncated outputs. Acceptance criteria should include: idempotent cancels, deterministic final status (succeeded/failed/cancelled/fallback_applied), and no token duplication in concatenated streaming + final response.

Ricardo: Proposed launch criteria (initial beta):
- JS + Python SDKs expose identical param names and behavior
- migration guide and examples for streaming + cancel semantics
- 3 beta customers (include PineHealth) validated in staging
- e2e tests covering: stream cancel, server fallback, retry exhaustion, and privacy flag behavior
- telemetry default remains opt-in for enterprise; hosted defaults unchanged

infra-bot: CI: SDK PR #452 — test_stream_cancel failing on macOS-latest (stack trace truncated)

Sam: I'll pick up that failing test. Also suggest we set conservative default retry: `maxAttempts=3, base=200ms, max=2000ms` — less surprising for customers.

Priya: For the privacy opt-out, acceptance criteria: a top-level config `sendPartialPrompts: boolean` (default true for self-serve, false toggle for enterprise), docs explaining latency/cost implications, and an integration test showing no prefix sent when false.

Alex: Agreed. Next actions: Jordan + Sam to draft RFC with the API surface, samples, and acceptance checklist. Ricardo to surface beta customers and legal for the privacy wording. Goal: RFC draft by EOD Friday. @Jordan @Sam @Ricardo

Mei: I'll add the edge-case matrix and unit/e2e test TODOs into the RFC branch.

Jordan: Opening a draft PR today: r/eng-sdk#789 — will tag reviewers and include the JS + Python sketches.

Alex: Thanks everyone — please add any missing acceptance criteria on the PR. :thumbsup:
